name: Epi-Olmec (Isthmian) Script
notes: Encompasses the disputed Cascajal Block (c. 900 BCE, recovered out of archaeological context, authenticity/status as writing contested) and the later La Mojarra Stela 1 / Tuxtla Statuette corpus (Isthmian script proper, 1st-2nd century CE). Whether these represent one continuous tradition or should be split is itself part of the dispute recorded in claim_cascajal_authenticity_disputed and claim_epi_olmec_decipherment_disputed.
